programme.desc: It's time to learn all about planes with Blippi! First, he's at Erin Air in Seattle, WA, and he's ready to explore a private jet! After learning about the different types of planes and making sure everything is good to go, it's time for takeoff! Then, Blippi visits another airfield to learn even more about planes! Blippi soars high above the city while taking a plane ride and then sings the popular Plane Song!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Meekah is learning all about cool vehicles! First, she's at a farm with a mission to learn about construction vehicles. She starts by digging up some objects with a mini excavator and then heads over to the backhoe to get crushin'! Then, she decides to help out around town by building a neighborhood car wash. Finally, she meets a professional race car driver and learns all about driving in NASCAR races!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's Monster Jammin time with Meekah! First, she watches a skid steer challenge a monster truck to a donut challenge! This gives her a great idea to use her Wonder Watch to shrink the trucks and have her own mini Jam. Then, it's a dancing scavenger hunt as Meekah digs her way around a construction site to see her favorite trucks on the move. As she follows Blippi's construction truck map, she creates a dance by watching each vehicle work.

programme.desc: Join JJ for his birthday celebration! His friends and family are setting up a surprise party, but things keep going wrong. From a party bus to a farm adventure and even a train ride, celebrate with games, gifts, and a hunt for Bingo!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Watch out, because these cute creatures are causing big chaos! First, Chroma the Magic Pet has a cold, and every time she sneezes, she causes a huge color splat! Mila and Morphle must find her before the whole city is covered in color. Then, the Baby Morphles arrive from another dimension and they are in the mood for a game of chase! From a giant living doll to a runaway magic pet, these cute creatures are causing chaos everywhere!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Join Mila and Morphle for a series of magical birthday adventures! They rescue a stolen magic pet for Winston, celebrate Morphle's own birthday when bandits steal the ice cream truck, and help Jordie get his cactus cake back from Orphle.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on some big day out adventures! First, the family visits the zoo to see all the amazing animals, like elephants, monkeys and hippos! Then, it's Baby John's first time at the water park, where he has lots of fun with water squirters and wading pools. The adventure continues with a trip to a fun theme park, where the family enjoys the merry-go-round, bumper cars and yummy cotton candy!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Baby John thinks his family members are the best heroes! He really loves and admires his dad, and wants to copy everything he does to be just like him. His big brother Jack is a hero, too, and is always willing to help his little brother and teach him new things. After Mom's cupcakes go missing, Baby John dresses up as a police officer to find out who took them, interviewing each of his family member heroes!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of teamwork and rescues at T-Rex Ranch! Tara and Asher are all set for a game of soccer, but a playful pterodactyl swoops in and snatches their ball! The two rangers must team up to get it back. Then, the rangers must race against time to find more food for the dinosaurs after Darren accidentally burns their dinner. The day ends with another rescue, as the kids must save Darren when some raptors start chasing him while he's learning to ride a bike!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Beware the evil shrink blaster at T-Rex Ranch! First, Park Rangers Aaron and LB receive a mysterious letter from Despicable G, but before they can discover its contents, they must first battle a giant T-Rex! Then, an intruder comes into the T-Rex ranch with a shrink blaster and starts making all the dinosaurs tiny! Can Park Rangers Cam and Darren team up to stop the intruder and save the day?

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a fun day at the dinosaur park! Park Rangers LB and Aaron embark on an exciting adventure when a paddock fence collapses. They must quickly work together to repair it to prevent the giant dinosaurs from escaping! Then, the two rangers visit Dinosaur World to check out the massive life-size dinosaurs. Later, they have a fun hide-and-seek challenge among the dinos, competing for a mystery prize. Who will win the thrilling game?

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! Bubbles accidentally brings back a cute little space alien, but it multiplies at an alarming rate and Oddsville is soon crawling with the creatures! Then, an experiment with Pogo's ice cream makes everyone who eats it weightless. Soon, they're all loving spinning around in the air, but it's not long before they find themselves drifting away! Plus, Fuse tries to get away from everyone by retreating to an island.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The cul-de-sac is dealing with some new arrivals! First, there's an alien invader, in the form of a popcorn-obsessed creature that has cloned itself to look exactly like Newt, who is trapped on its spaceship! Then, Zee has the misfortune of having to babysit his disruptive niece and nephew who seem intent on wrecking both his home and his head! Plus, a pleasant afternoon barbecue takes a turn for the worse for Jeff.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of science experiments with Meekah! First, she visits the Glazer Children's Museum, where she plays a fun game of sink or float, serves customers in the play restaurants and builds a fort, all while counting! Then, Blippi and Meekah visit the Ontario Science Centre to learn about gravity and electricity. They build a rollercoaster, see water react to music and even see a Hot Air Balloon!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a bouncy day of sports and play! First, she jumps and plays her way through Sky Zone Trampoline Park. She climbs play structures, goes down slides and even tests her ninja skills in the ninja course! Along the way, she meets some special dino friends! Then, Explorer Meekah searches for shapes and learns about the different balls used in sports. She goes around the indoor playground discovering new ways to bounce, roll and dunk them!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time for some indoor and outdoor playtime with Blippi! First, Blippi plays on an outdoor park playground, where he slides down some slides, climbs on monkey bars and crawls through tunnels! He even finds a cool zipline to ride. Then, Blippi visits an indoor playground where he learns all about lots of different emotions, such as happy, sad and excited, and why it's important to feel all of them sometimes!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is exploring some mighty machines at work! First, he visits a construction yard to learn all about skid steers. He explores all the parts of the skid steer, inside and out, while learning how they work and how they're used. Then, Blippi takes you for a ride inside a real forklift! He learns about these amazing construction trucks as he explores all their different parts before trying his hand at lifting something with the forklift himself!

programme.title: CoComelon

Mommy guides JJ through his nighttime routine of brushing his teeth, taking a bath and reading a story before he drifts off to sleep.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for his birthday adventures! He has a balloon boat race, a surprise party on the bus, and plays follow-the-leader with Dad. Go on a magical train ride and help find the missing birthday dog, Bingo!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: A strange ray accidentally zaps Hye and Lo, making them so brilliant that they defy Adilla and begin using their new intellect to help the Insectibles create peace. Their efforts are complicated when Zak mistakes their help for an attack. At the same time, Gramps invents a helmet camera to offer technical support on missions, but his constant stream of advice becomes more of a hindrance than a help, creating chaos from two different sources.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Lidia discovers a remote that can control Willow's bionic drill, but Adilla quickly snatches it, gaining mind-control over the Insectibles' friend. Before she can use this new power to her advantage, a new crisis emerges. The roaches find a magic 8-ball and declare it their new leader, and its first comm and is to destroy the Shrinkinator. Adilla must now team up with her arch-enemy Zak to save the very machine she has been trying to steal.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The moment of triumph is here as Gramps and Zak find the final piece of the Shrinkinator! But their celebration is cut short when Adilla captures the entire team. After a daring escape, the Insectibles brace for a final showdown. While Syd rallies the other bugs in the yard for support, Zak, Willow, and Chowser mount a desperate defense of the shed, with Zak facing Adilla one last time to stop her from activating the Shrinkinator and claiming victory.

programme.title: Supa Strikas

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an amazing indoor playtime adventure at three different fun locations! First, he plays around in Giggle Jungle, where he helps us learn about lots of different colors in a bright and colorful play park! Then, he visits Fidgets Indoor Playground, where he skips along while learning movement verbs like crawl, run and roll! The fun ends at Juzplay indoor playground, where kids will learn colors, shapes and so much more!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready to go fast on land and sea with Blippi! First, let's go to the go-kart track! We'll learn so much about go-karts, including the different types, how the fun small vehicles work and even some colors! Then, Blippi learns about jet skis! After putting on his wet suit and his sun cream, and making sure there's enough fuel in the tank, it's time for Blippi to take a speedy ride across the water!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Pogo wants to go skydiving with Newt, but she doesn't want to go. He soon discovers the only thing that can get her to agree: the final sticker for her collection. Then, Pogo gets his hands on Bubbles' mind control chips and picks poor Fuse as the object of his latest experiment! Finally, Pogo convinces the others a monster is on the loose, but it's just another one of his pranks.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are taking on some new roles! First, Fuse chops down a tree and finds himself the reluctant parent to a hatchling chick. Will the cute baby bird melt his heart? Then, as a stickler for the rules, Jeff is appointed warden for the cul-de-sac, but he soon gets a taste for his newfound power! Plus, a mysterious UFO keeps stealing cows from nearby fields, and Bubbles goes to investigate.

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Spring has sprung, and so have the Antiks! Join them as they explore a world of blossoming flowers and fresh spring treats. From climbing giant mushrooms to navigating through a garden of delights, their adventures are as colorful as the season. It's a story about discovery, teamwork, and enjoying the sweet tastes of spring.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!
